caption: The drawing depicts a hand-crank coffee grinder placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The grinder consists of a round, metallic bowl at the top, colored in shades of brown with highlights suggesting a copper or brass material. Attached to the bowl is a long, horizontal handle with a knob at the end, matching the brown metallic color. Beneath the bowl, a circular wooden or wooden-like base is illustrated, also brown in color with some darker and lighter shading to indicate texture and curvature. The grinder's base includes a small rectangular drawer at the front, depicted as slightly recessed with a dark interior. The entire object is rendered with detailed shadowing and gentle highlights to emphasize its three-dimensional form. The overall composition is centered, with the coffee grinder isolated against the empty background, and the words "HAROLD D WALSH" appearing faintly below the grinder in small, uppercase, reddish text.
title: Coffee Grinder
